# Third-party methods

The current snapshot contains MATLAB functions named `BPCA`, `GLRAM`, and `projected_estimator`. Their provenance, version, and license were not included in the submission. Before publication, add citations and license notices for every baseline, or replace the functions with clearly referenced implementations.

The manuscript and repository must use one consistent method mapping. Names such as UMPCA, TROD, PARAFAC, NewGreedy, and NonGreedy must not be used interchangeably without corresponding source files and citations.
